# Summary (subagent → main session)

At most about 40 lines. No raw logs: give counts and key error lines, with a path to any saved log.

## Status
Done, partial, or blocked, in one line.

## Results
What changed or what was found, with `path:line` references. Commands run and their real results.

## Decisions
Any decision made, and why.

## Open questions
Anything that needs the main session or the user.
